design: Eighteen full paired off/on trials. RANDOM-04 uses the exact compressed 2799 recipe at planner seeds0..4; RANDOM-01/02/03/05 use their selected745/1408/2646/4302 profiles and selected seeds. Only R05_MATCH_SKIP_ZERO changes within each pair. Keep all declared startup/full search work, matching objective, task policy and horizons fixed.
hypothesis: Exact zero-increment dual update elision removes redundant full-column write scans, especially from tied mandatory/optional idle matching. Sampled scan and zero counts test whether it targets the measured dense startup bottleneck.
validation: Independent full source/input/allocation/movement/assignment/event/waiting audit; strict1000ms entry,30000ms prep,32decimalGB,16boundphysical/32SMT workers. Sixteen declared historical exact references; seed2 has no valid prior full score. Any completed off/on pair must match all six trace fields. Failed attempts remain failures and never receive historical substitute scores.
selection: RANDOM-04 seed2 may newly complete if runtime improves; an improved selected score in that event would be a planner-seed maximum, not evidence of changed assignment/search choices. Report each distinction explicitly.
heldouts: No fresh input or heldout seed is used; all selected map/horizon/admission settings retain explicit --trick INSTANCE.
